blocks.text: Yeh chapter homeostasis ka mutala karta hai: thermoregulation aur osmoregulation ke tareeqe aur insani sehat aur baqa ke liye andaruni mahol ko mustahkam rakhne ki ahmiyat.

blocks.title: Homeostasis
blocks.text: Homeostasis woh amal hai jis se jaandar bairooni mahol ki tabdeeliyon ke bawajood apna andaruni mahol (internal environment) mustahkam rakhte hain, kai tareeqe mil kar kaam karte hain.
Homeostasis ke aham amal thermoregulation (jism ke darja-e-hararat ka qaboo), osmoregulation (pani aur ghulne wale madde ka qaboo) aur excretion (metabolic fuzlaat ka ikhraj) hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi istilah thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion teeno ko shamil karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Homeostasis: teeno andaruni mahol ko mustahkam rakhte hain.

items: Homeostasis andaruni mahol mustahkam rakhta hai; is mein thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion shamil hain.
